title: Competent navigation of spaces is an invariant of cognition

statements.text: Competent navigation in arbitrary spaces, metabolic, transcriptional, morphological and three-dimensional, is the invariant that tracks the scaling of cognition across evolution, independent of scale and implementation.

sources.quote: propose competent navigation in arbitrary spaces as an invariant for thinking about the scaling of cognition during evolution
We propose an observer-focused viewpoint that is agnostic about scale and implementation
